rule: State the strongest conclusion supported by the evidence while preserving proposition boundaries and residual uncertainty.

assessments.text: Iran's conventional navy suffered catastrophic losses; this does not mean every IRGC small craft was destroyed.
basis: CSIS open-source/satellite assessment documents near-total conventional surface-fleet loss.
AP reports more than 90% of the regular navy lost while noting Revolutionary Guard small attack boats remained.

assessments.text: The CAOC was knocked out. Al Udeid was not.
basis: Multiple Iranian missiles rendered the CAOC inoperable.
The air campaign continued through preplanned distributed command at Shaw; the record does not establish whole-base incapacity.

assessments.text: Iran shot down the F-15E. The subsequent personnel-recovery mission succeeded. Claims that it was actually a uranium-seizure raid remain unsupported.
basis: Canonical chain corrects the initial F-35 identification to F-15E.
Both crew were recovered; disabled recovery aircraft were destroyed by U.S. forces to prevent capture.
A separate uranium contingency existed, but no operation-specific evidence links it to the rescue.
